custom_logic_notes: Classic Hans123 breakout strategy: places pending buy/sell stop orders at the high/low of two defined time sessions. Orders are placed at session end times and cancelled if not triggered by end of day. The EA identifies consolidation ranges during London and NY morning sessions, then trades breakouts from those ranges.
python_conversion_notes: Session high/low detection requires tracking bar extremes within time windows. Pending order placement at session end. Must implement time-based session window logic. SL/TP require digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers (multiply by 10). End-of-day cleanup logic needed for cancelling unfilled orders and closing open positions.
